items.title: Ten advances in mathematics and theoretical computer science
items.title_zh: OpenAI 公布数学与理论计算机科学领域十大进展
items.title_en: OpenAI Highlights Ten Advances in AI for Mathematics and Theoretical CS
items.summary: OpenAI highlights ten recent breakthroughs in using AI for mathematics and theoretical computer science, sparking a major community discussion about the future of mathematical research.

items.title: LLMs reward expertise
items.summary: The article argues that LLMs amplify existing expertise, providing greater benefits to experts than novices, contrary to the expectation that they would democratize technical skills.

items.title: MiniMax H3 Day-0 Support in ComfyUI: Open Weights, Native Audio, and 2K Video
items.title_zh: ComfyUI 首日支持 MiniMax H3，带来开源 2K 视频生成与原生音频
items.title_en: ComfyUI Adds Day-0 Support for MiniMax H3 with 2K Video and Audio
items.summary: ComfyUI adds Day-0 support for MiniMax H3, enabling open-weights 2K video generation with native audio and a memory-reducing pruning technique.

items.title: Andy Pavlo joins ClickHouse to establish ClickHouse Labs
items.title_zh: Andy Pavlo 加入 ClickHouse 创立并领导 ClickHouse Labs
items.title_en: Andy Pavlo joins ClickHouse to lead new ClickHouse Labs
items.summary: Andy Pavlo, a leading database researcher and CMU professor, is joining ClickHouse to establish and lead ClickHouse Labs.

items.title: Bonsai: Janestreet's UI Library
items.title_zh: Jane Street 的 Bonsai：让 OCaml 实现全栈 Web 开发
items.title_en: Jane Street's Bonsai Brings Full-Stack OCaml to the Web
items.summary: Jane Street's Bonsai is an OCaml UI library enabling shared types and logic across frontend and backend, generating significant community discussion.

items.title: SQLite Critical CVEs or LLM Slop?
items.title_zh: SQLite CVE 噪音：LLM 垃圾内容还是真实漏洞？
items.title_en: SQLite CVE Noise: LLM Slop or Real Vulnerabilities?
items.summary: An analysis of how LLM-generated false reports are contributing to noise in CVE databases, using SQLite as a case study, and sparking debate about the risks and benefits of AI in security research.

items.title: Kimi K3, The Manos, The Mythos, The Legendos
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 架构深度解析：压缩记忆、潜在专家路由与推理性能
items.title_en: Kimi K3 Architecture Deep Dive: Compressed Memory, Latent Experts, Inference
items.summary: An in-depth analysis of Kimi K3's architecture highlighting compressed memory, attention across depth, latent expert routing, and inference performance.

items.title: 美犯罪实验室 DNA 设备曝漏洞，30 年证据文件面临篡改风险
items.title_zh: 赛默飞修复DNA分析漏洞，30年法医证据面临篡改风险
items.title_en: Thermo Fisher Patches DNA Analysis Flaw Risking 30 Years of Forensic Evidence
items.summary: Security flaws in DNA analysis equipment used by US crime labs could allow attackers to undetectably alter 30 years of forensic evidence, with the vendor issuing a digital-signature patch and warnings.

items.title: 美至少 50 名警员被控滥用车牌摄像头窥探前任
items.title_zh: 美至少50名警员被控滥用车牌摄像头窥探前任
items.title_en: At Least 50 US Officers Accused of Abusing License-Plate Cameras to Stalk Exes
items.summary: A Washington Post investigation reveals at least 50 US officers were accused of misusing license-plate cameras, including Flock systems, to stalk ex-partners, highlighting widespread surveillance abuse and weak oversight.

items.title: 英伟达 170HX 矿卡被破解：最高解锁 80 GB 显存，二手价暴涨
items.title_zh: 英伟达170HX矿卡被破解：解锁80GB显存，二手价暴涨
items.title_en: Nvidia CMP 170HX Cracking Unlocks 80GB VRAM, Sends Prices Soaring
items.summary: Researchers publicly disclosed a method to crack Nvidia CMP 170HX mining cards, unlocking up to 80GB VRAM and 94 TFLOPS FP32, causing secondary market prices to soar.

items.title: 英国政府再次要求苹果开放云存储数据访问权限  英国内政部于 9 月初向苹果发出新的技术能力通知，要求其为加密云备份创建后门，但这次仅针对英国公民数据。
items.title_zh: 英国再要求苹果为加密云备份开后门
items.title_en: UK Demands Apple Backdoor for Encrypted Cloud Backups
items.summary: UK government issues new technical capability notice to Apple demanding a backdoor for encrypted cloud backups, limited to UK citizen data.
